channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: GAIN SSA: AI Safety Essentials Fellowship (inaugural cohort)
item.description: GAIN SSA (Global AI Youth Network, Sub-Saharan Africa) · deadline 08 Nov 2026 · Micro-grant pool funding top capstone proposals at USD 500 to 1,000 each (capped at USD 1,000), usable for compute access, communication work such as Substack Pro subscriptions for writers, or travel to AI alignment conferences in Sub-Saharan Africa. The fellowship itself is free to attend (no participation fee, no application fee); no stipend is paid during the program.

item.title: Internet Society Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Internet Society · deadline 18 Dec 2026 · Project stipend of up to USD 5,000 (upon submission and approval of the project budget), plus travel support to attend a global or regional Internet event and a dedicated mentor aligned with the project area. No application fee.

item.title: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab: Visiting Fellowships 2027 (Leuven)
item.description: KU Leuven AI Safety Lab · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · EUR 2,000 per month for three months, covering accommodation and living costs, plus office space, library access and KU Leuven facilities. Five fellowships. No application fee.

item.title: The Open Notebook Early-Career Fellowship 2027 (remote)
item.description: The Open Notebook · deadline 31 Oct 2026 · USD 6,600 stipend over the twelve-month part-time fellowship, plus one-on-one mentoring from an experienced science journalist and published clips at The Open Notebook. No application fee.

item.title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28 (Lisbon)
item.description: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study (GIAS), Calouste Gulbenkian Foundation · deadline 15 Oct 2026 · Up to 15 fellowships a year. Each covers travel costs, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing subsidy; the stipend level is set at selection based on CV and length of stay. No application fee.

item.title: Braunschweig Projects 2027/28: Curatorial Fellowship at HBK Braunschweig
item.description: Braunschweig University of Art (HBK Braunschweig), on behalf of the State of Lower Saxony · deadline 04 Oct 2026 · Stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for 12 months (EUR 19,200 total), plus a rent-free one-person studio apartment in Braunschweig (the fellow pays EUR 250 per month towards incidental living costs), a subsidy of up to EUR 4,000 for exhibition activities and a EUR 2,000 travel budget. No application fee.

item.title: Asymmetry Assistant Curator Fellowship 2027-2029 at Nottingham Contemporary
item.description: Asymmetry Art Foundation, with Nottingham Contemporary · deadline 25 Oct 2026 · Annual salary of GBP 27,556 for two years, plus pension and National Insurance contributions, annual leave in line with organisational policy plus UK bank holidays, visa and legal fee assistance where required, and a travel and relocation allowance. No application fee.

item.title: Nieman Fellowships at Harvard, Class of 2028
item.description: Nieman Foundation for Journalism at Harvard · deadline 01 Dec 2026 · USD 87,500 stipend paid over the nine-month academic year (2026-27 figure), plus additional allowances for housing, childcare and health insurance. Fellows audit courses across Harvard and participate in Nieman seminars, master classes and workshops. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: IAPS: AI Policy Fellowship Spring 2027 (DC, London or remote)
item.description: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS) · deadline 27 Sep 2026 · Fellows receive USD 18,000 and Senior Fellows USD 24,000 as a stipend for the three-month full-time program, plus an additional USD 3,000 stipend on the in-person DC or London tracks, healthcare benefits and a USD 500 professional development stipend. Up to 45 fellows. No application fee.

item.title: Anthropic Fellows Program (funded AI research fellowship, January 2027 cohort)
item.description: Anthropic (with Constellation as recruiting partner) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 3,850 / GBP 2,310 / CAD 4,300 per week for four months of full-time research, plus roughly USD 15,000 per month in compute funding and other research expenses. No application fee.

item.title: FAS: AI Safety Policy Entrepreneurship Fellowship 2026-27 (part-time, remote)
item.description: Federation of American Scientists (Day One Project) · deadline 07 Sep 2026 · USD 5,000 stipend for the part-time fellowship (about 5 hours per week), plus a USD 1,000 merit award for the most actionable policy memo and advocacy plan. No application fee.

item.title: Mycelia Fellowship 2026 (Social Resonance Lab)
item.description: Social Resonance Lab · deadline 13 Sep 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend per fellow; two fellows selected for the inaugural cohort

item.title: Tech Policy Press Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Tech Policy Press · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend per fellow, paid quarterly. Also included: editorial guidance from the Tech Policy Press team, membership of an international cohort with regular feedback and exchange, and monthly sessions to strengthen the work. Fellows' work is published on the Tech Policy Press website and promoted through the newsletter, podcast and events. No application fee.

item.title: 5 new fellowships - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • The Impart & Nalli Fellowships 2027-28
    https://imp-art.org/fellowship-grant/impart-x-nalli-fellowships/
    Impart in collaboration with Nalli Silks · deadline 31 Aug 2026 · Up to INR 5.5 lakhs (INR 550,000) per fellow towards project execution, covering research-related expenses including travel, fieldwork and documentation subject to approval. Two fellowships are awarded. No application fee.
  • New_ Public Entrepreneur in Residence, Pilot Cohort
    https://newpublic.org/EIR
    New_ Public · deadline 09 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 22,500, paid in three monthly installments across the residency, each contingent on continued active participation. Plus USD 1,500 toward an AI tool of the resident's choice for coding, prototyping or design. Two residents are selected in the pilot cohort. Also provided: hands-on product and strategy support from senior New_ Public staff and outside experts; access to New_ Public's five years of original research on moderation, governance, community stewardship and platform design, plus direct access to the researchers behind it; and introductions across New_ Public's network of major platforms, startups, university researchers and funders for hiring, fundraising, early user testing and community partnerships. Residents must submit a Form W-9 or W-8BEN to receive the stipend. No application fee.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
  • ILIAD Intensive: Foundational AI Alignment Program (London and Berkeley)
    https://www.iliad.ac/intensive
    ILIAD · deadline Rolling / undated · No tuition. USD 5,000 travel and housing allowance per participant, plus office space at the venue and lunch and dinner five days a week. Cohorts of 15 to 30 participants. Participants arrange and pay for their own travel and accommodation out of the allowance.

item.title: 3 new fellowships - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Physical AI Safety Institute: Research Fellowship (expression of interest)
    https://airtable.com/appYKevtFovAswTXz/pagtcy2ye0OeFf04d/form
    Physical AI Safety Institute (PAISI) · deadline Rolling / undated · Stipend amount is not published. Fellows receive a stipend, access to physical robot platforms, compute for simulation and training, and structured mentorship. PAISI was seeded by a grant from BlueDot Impact. Free to submit an expression of interest.
  • AIXI Labs: Research Fellowship (rolling, quarterly rounds)
    https://www.aixi.uk/team/opportunities/aixi-labs-fellowship/
    AIXI Labs · deadline Rolling / undated · GBP 2,000 to GBP 3,500 per month stipend, plus a compute budget for machine-learning work. Free to apply.
  • Luminos.AI Legal Engineering Fellowship (Fall 2026)
    https://www.luminos.ai/jobs/luminos-ai-fellowship-program-fall-2026
    Luminos.AI · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 35 per hour, part-time. No application fee.

item.title: 2 new fellowships - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• AI Builders Fellowship 2026 (Internet Archive Canada x BC + AI)
    https://bc-ai.ca/fellowship
    Internet Archive Canada (IAC) in partnership with BC + AI · deadline 21 Aug 2026 · $5,000 award for one selected builder. No application fee.
  • Sundance Institute: Episodic Program and Lab 2027
    https://filmfreeway.com/SundanceEpisodicLab2027
    Sundance Institute · deadline 25 Aug 2026 · No stipend or honorarium for participation. For the in-person Lab, Sundance covers round-trip basic economy airfare from the airport nearest the fellow's residence, shared housing with a private room and bath, and ground transport to and from the airport (fellows within 100 miles of the Lab get ground transport only). Meals, in-room charges, travel insurance, luggage fees and taxes are the fellow's own cost. One selected project also receives a separate monetary grant from the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation for a series with an illuminating emphasis on science, including medicine, energy, technology or invention. APPLICATION FEE: USD 50 nonrefundable processing fee per project submitted.

item.title: 4 new fellowships - week of 03 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Kennan Institute Digital Fellowship 2026-2027
    https://www.kennaninstitute.org/digital-fellowship
    Kennan Institute, Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars (supported by the Lounsbery Foundation and the U.S. Russia Foundation) · deadline 14 Aug 2026 · USD 2,000 monthly stipend for the six-month programme, plus mentorship from the Kennan community of experts, six virtual webinars tailored to the cohort, and inclusion in the Kennan alumni network of over 4,500 people. Travel and visa costs are explicitly not covered. No application fee.
  • AIAF Fellowship, Autumn 2026
    https://www.aialignmentfoundation.org/fellowship
    AI Alignment Foundation · deadline 17 Aug 2026 · USD 12,000 stipend paid in two installments, plus a compute budget. Travel covered for in-person Demo Day attendance. No application fee.
  • Instituto Sacatar: Sacatar Fellowship 2027 (Bahia, Brazil)
    https://sacatar.org/en/fellowships/
    Instituto Sacatar · deadline 28 Aug 2026 · Fully hosted residency: private bedroom with attached bathroom, three meals a day (except Saturday evenings, Sundays and Brazilian holidays), an individual studio suited to the discipline, weekly laundry, logistical support and airport transfer from Salvador. NO STIPEND, no airfare and no materials budget. USD 25 application fee. One French artist may additionally receive airfare and a stipend through Villa Fatumbi.
  • Wilson Center Research Fellowship, 2027-2028 Class
    https://www.wilsoncenter.org/research-fellowship
    Woodrow Wilson International Center for Scholars · deadline 30 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 per month for a twelve-month fellowship, plus covered travel for the two required trips to Washington DC. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new fellowship - week of 27 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Good Life Residents Program: AI and Finance
    https://rooseveltinstitute.org/careers/good-life-resident-program/
    Roosevelt Institute, in partnership with Data & Society · deadline 12 Aug 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend, plus travel and accommodation for the culminating event if needed. No application fee.

item.title: 4 new fellowships - week of 06 Jul 2026
item.description:
• Global Artivism: Governance Fellow
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/governancefellow-globalartivism
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,200 to 1,800 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
  • Global Artivism: Operations Fellow
    https://www.abm-intelligence.com/operationsfellow-globalartivism
    Global Artivism (a fiscally sponsored project of Res Publica US Inc.) · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · USD 1,000 to 1,500 per month (independent contractor fee), paid on receipt of monthly invoices. No employee benefits, paid leave, or insurance; contractor covers their own taxes and compliance.
  • Mountainfilm: Commitment Grants & Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship
    https://www.mountainfilm.org/mountainfilm-initiatives/commitment-grants/
    Mountainfilm · deadline 16 Jul 2026 · Over USD 90,000 in total funding. Individual Commitment Grants range from USD 3,000 to 6,000. The Emerging Filmmaker Fellowship adds a yearlong mentorship, a cash award, and a funded trip to Telluride over Memorial Day weekend (travel, lodging, and a festival pass).
  • Digital Impact Alliance (DIAL) Research Fellowship
    https://dial.global/apply-to-our-fellows-program/
    Digital Impact Alliance (DIAL) · deadline Rolling / undated · USD 5,000 stipend for a 6-8 month fellowship. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new fellowship - week of 22 Jun 2026
item.description:
• Artivism & Amplifiers Fellowship 2026
    https://www.humanimpactsinstitute.org/opportunities
    Human Impacts Institute · deadline 01 Jul 2026 · USD 1,000 stipend upon completion. Supported by expert workshops and creative mentors.
